backend/main.mo: Defines comment list storage and provides query and update methods for generating single or bulk comments with usage tracking and access key validation.
backend/migration.mo: Defines migration types and returns a new empty actor state with initialized comment lists, rating images, and chat messages.
feature_evidence.json: Contains feature evidence entries mapping features to related frontend files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Provides human‑written summaries of existing frontend files for reference and planning.
frontend/index.css: Defines global Tailwind CSS variables and theming for light/dark modes with pastel color tokens.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entry point mounting the React root element and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up routing for Customer View, Upload Section, and Admin Panel with admin gating and React Query/Theme providers.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminChatT: UI for admins to view and send chat messages using chat hooks, with message validation and timestamp formatting.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminComme: Admin interface to create, manage, upload, and delete comment lists with bulk and single modes.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminImage: Displays all rating images with uploader info and allows admins to delete images.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminSetti: Manages the bulk generator access key, showing current status and allowing updates or resets.
frontend/src/components/AdminTokenGate.t: Gates admin-only pages using useAdminToken and shows loading or access-denied states.
frontend/src/components/SiteLayout.tsx: Wraps pages with background, top segmented navigation, page container, and footer.
Renders the top segmented navigation showing Customer View, Upload Section, and admin-only Admin Panel with active highlighting.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous backend actor and refreshes dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminComments.ts: React-query hooks for fetching and mutating comment lists, single comments, bulk uploads, and related metadata.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminToken.ts: Checks for a valid admin token in the URL or session storage and exposes admin access state.
frontend/src/hooks/useBulkGeneratorKey.t: Hooks to query, set, and reset the bulk generator access key via the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useChatMessages.ts: React Query hooks for fetching, adding, and invalidating chat messages via the actor API.
frontend/src/hooks/useCommentGenerator.t: Hooks for listing comment sets, generating single or bulk comments, and checking bulk key status using the actor API.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity context and authentication handling using Dfinity AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useRatingImages.ts: Hooks for uploading, fetching, and deleting rating images through the actor API.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup with custom themes, utilities, and animation keyframes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entry point setting up React Query and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPanelPage.tsx: Admin dashboard with tabs for comments, images, chat, and settings.
frontend/src/pages/CustomerViewPage.tsx: Customer interface for generating single or bulk comments with list selection and optional key input.
frontend/src/pages/UploadSectionPage.tsx: Image upload page allowing users to submit rating images with progress tracking.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers to read URL parameters (including hash routing), store and retrieve them from sessionStorage, and clear them when needed.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind CSS with custom colors, fonts, radius, dark mode, content paths, and animation/typography plugins.
project_state.json: Tracks project metadata, required UI features, and current rebuild scope for the app’s customer, upload, and admin sections.
